entries.snippet: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.

entries.title: Thousands of people under evacuation order from wildfires in Spokane, Wash.
entries.snippet: There are at least three fires in and around the city. Large parts of Spokane are under Level 3 evacuation orders, which read: "Leave NOW! This may be your only notice."

entries.title: Why is the rate of premature births so high in this community?
entries.snippet: About 1 in 4 babies in the Pakistani fishing settlement of Rehri Goth are born prematurely. Researchers are trying to figure out how to bring the numbers down.

entries.title: We asked a first grader to interview his hero: A bird scientist
entries.snippet: NPR asked an aspiring scientist in Philadelphia to interview an adult who is living his dream about his career in conservation science.

entries.title: What Cyclospora does inside the gut and how it gets there

entries.snippet: Vincent Pastore appeared in movies dating back to the 1980s and had roles in big movies including "Goodfellas" and "Awakenings," both in 1990.

entries.title: Senate leaders reach funding deal to avoid shutdown during campaign season
entries.snippet: The Senate is likely to vote on the measure before leaving Washington at week's end for its traditional August recess, a period that many lawmakers want to spend shoring up their reelection prospects rather than working in the nation's capital.

entries.title: Ken Martin hunkers down at the Democratic National Committee as a storm gathers around party leader
entries.snippet: Desperate to save his job as chair of the Democratic National Committee, he is avoiding media appearances, monitoring his critics' social media posts and refusing — at least so far — to make any substantive changes at his troubled organization.

entries.title: Trump frequently announces he's halting strikes in Iran. But they keep happening
entries.snippet: The abrupt shifts have been a defining feature of the five-month conflict that has sent prices of oil and basic goods soaring — and the announcements to date have been upended by renewed attacks days or even hours afterward.

entries.title: Eastern Washington fires have burned 600 structures and forced the evacuation of 5,000 homes
entries.snippet: The fires burned more than 8.2 square miles around Spokane, the second largest city in Washington, and were among dozens across the western U.S. — stretching the ability of federal, state and local agencies to fight them.

entries.title: Ceuta grapples with aftermath of border surge after most migrants leave the Spanish territory
entries.snippet: Most of the 60,000 migrants who swam, scrambled and later charged into the tiny Spanish exclave in North Africa this week had walked back to Morocco by Sunday, but some stayed on in the hills surrounding the city.

entries.title: Fact-checking Trump's claims about how the Iran war is going
entries.snippet: Even as a ceasefire was crumbling, leading the U.S. to wage new attacks on Iran, President Donald Trump touted the United States' war as a success.

entries.title: Israel says it has serious concerns with Hamas disarmament deal
entries.snippet: Doron Spielman, spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister's office, told The Associated Press that Israel's intelligence assessment is that Hamas remains committed to rebuilding its military rather than genuinely demilitarizing.

entries.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno says former son-in-law Max Miller should not serve in the House

entries.title: Moscow mayor calls a deadly bomb attack on a restaurant a 'terrorist act'

entries.snippet: The four crew members were recovered after the collision, the Greek fire department said, adding that two were recovered safely, while the other two were unconscious.

entries.snippet: Investigators are confident that the gunman, identified as 24-year-old Chad Williams, acted alone during the shooting Saturday in Twin Falls, Police Chief Matthew Hicks said at a news conference.

entries.title: Darline Graham promotes Trump's agenda in her political debut ahead of special Senate primary
entries.snippet: As one of nine Republicans seeking to replace him more permanently in a special primary election set for Aug. 11, Graham is a relative political unknown facing off against some of the state's best-known GOP names.

entries.title: Democrats see a chance to flip a seat as focus on abuse claims mounts against Ohio Rep. Max Miller
entries.snippet: Allegations against Rep. Max Miller have been public for years but have recently drawn increased media scrutiny amid an escalating legal back-and-forth with his former spouse, who is the daughter of Sen. Bernie Moreno.

entries.title: Trump blasts Pirro after she refutes his claim that Reflecting Pool was damaged by vandals
entries.snippet: Pirro's office, in a court filing on Friday, moved to drop criminal charges against a former Olympian, David Hearn, who had been accused of deliberately damaging the pool after it went through a renovation.

entries.title: Trump threatens more strikes on Iran. Tensions from Hormuz to Kuwait and Gaza lead to more warnings

entries.title: All 10 climbers swept away in avalanche in Pakistan are confirmed dead
entries.snippet: The 10-member expedition was swept away by an avalanche Thursday on Pakistan's Broad Peak.

entries.title: Heat wave expected to bring record-breaking temps, heighten wildfire risk to parts of Western U.S.
entries.snippet: A ridge of high pressure is holding heat close to the ground — what's known as a heat dome — from Arizona to Montana, though the good news is that it will be relatively short-lived, National Weather Service meteorologists said.

entries.title: Trump's threat to push ahead on settlement fund injects new uncertainty into attorney general talks
entries.snippet: Trump asserted in a Truth Social post that he would keep acting Attorney General Todd Blanche in his current role and press ahead on the "Anti-Weaponization Fund" if Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis refuse to back Blanche.

entries.title: Infantino abandoned his World Cup equity plan after seismic FIFA backlash. Here's what to know
entries.snippet: "Having listened carefully to all the views, it has become clear that the project has created divisions of a nature that, regardless of the level of support, are no longer in the interest of the objective set out in the first place," Infantino said in a statement.

entries.title: Spain installs sea barrier on Ceuta's border with Morocco after frontier rush that killed 67
entries.snippet: At least 67 migrants died, including some who drowned and others who were killed in a stampede to cross a breakwater barrier, the Spanish government said Saturday.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Pakistan: Suicide bomber kills 14 at anti-militancy protest
entries.snippet: A suicide bomber has killed over a dozen people including police in an attack during a demonstration of citizens against militancy. More than 18 people were injured in the attack.

entries.title: Ukraine hits targets deep inside Russia, killing eight
entries.snippet: Ukrainian drone strikes inside Russia killed eight people overnight in attacks that targeted military and civilian infrastructure. Russia said Moscow's forces downed 635 drones in the assault.

entries.title: Ceuta: Most who breached border have left, Spain says
entries.snippet: Nearly all of the more than 50,000 migrants who breached the border this week have returned to Morocco, according to Spanish officials. At least 72 people died in the border rush. DW has more.

entries.title: Greece: Fire brigade helicopters collide as wildfires spread
entries.snippet: The crew of one of the helicopters is reported to be safe but the search for the second is ongoing. Prime Minister Mitsotakis has warned of "extremely difficult" days ahead, while one expert has referred to a "megafire."

entries.title: Small insects, big damage: The global ant trade is booming
entries.snippet: Legal or not, the trade in African ants bound for Europe is booming. What do hobbyists find appealing about these insects, and what risks does the trade pose to ecosystems, including power outages?

entries.title: Germany news: DB hampered by 'organized irresponsibility'
entries.snippet: DB chief Evelyn Palla wants to overcome the culture of ''organized irresponsibility" by empowering new decision-makers within the railway operator. Bavarian brass musicians have wrapped up a 72-hour concert. DW has more.

entries.title: Moscow restaurant blast a 'brutal terror attack,' mayor says
entries.snippet: The deadly explosion outside an upscale Moscow restaurant at Kudrinskaya Square was a "brutal terror attack," Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said, promising the perpetrators would be punished. But many questions remain.

entries.title: Indonesia: At least 5 dead in ferry fire
entries.snippet: Search and rescue officials report some 41 missing after a fire on a ferry near the Indonesia island of Madura. The cause of the blaze remains unclear.

entries.title: Poland: Prime Minister Tusk defies anti-Ukrainian violence
entries.snippet: Anti-Ukrainian sentiment in Poland is on the rise, with numerous attacks against refugees from the war in Ukraine. Prime Minister Donald Tusk has spoken out against the violence and warned of the danger from Russia.

entries.title: Germany: Islamism and right-wing extremism — a story of mutual radicalization
entries.snippet: Following the attack on a Berlin Pride festival, the focus in Germany is turning to Islamist terrorism. An expert warns: Looking only at Islamists overlooks the parallels with right-wing extremism.

entries.title: Germany: As temperatures rise, so does climate skepticism
entries.snippet: Some 98% of active climate scientists say climate change is happening, and is man-made. Nonetheless, a new study shows the number of climate-change skeptics in Germany has increased. Why is that?

entries.title: China: Dozens dead in Gansu flash floods
entries.snippet: Chinese authorities will launch an investigation into the floods, amid warnings of further landslides as the rainy weather continues.

entries.title: On the front line of Europe's battle against wildfires
entries.snippet: French firefighters have won out over a massive blaze, with almost 200,000 evacuees returning home. But Europe's climate-fueled wildfire season is far from over.

entries.title: No new Iran strikes for now amid deal hopes — Trump
entries.snippet: Donald Trump says the US and Israel have agreed to hold off on strikes on Iran if a peace deal is reached "rapidly." Iran has vowed a decisive response to any new aggression. DW has more.

entries.title: US: Multiple dead in shooting at In-N-Out Burger in Idaho
entries.snippet: Multiple people were killed in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in southern Idaho. The suspected shooter is dead, police said.

entries.title: Hungary to shut sole nuclear plant for first time on Sunday
entries.snippet: Record-low water levels on the Danube forced the Paks plant offline, leaving Hungary facing a potential power crunch. In neighboring Serbia, energy production at two hydroelectric plants has also been reduced.

entries.title: 13 killed in tourist plane crash in Peru
entries.snippet: The plane was taking tourists to see the Nazca Lines, a group of geoglyphs etched into the deserts of southern Peru.

entries.title: How does eastern Europe commemorate the Roma Holocaust?
entries.snippet: In 2015, the EU designated August 2 as the European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day. In Germany, the day is marked with memorial services, educational activites and public addresses. And in eastern Europe?

entries.title: Germany's long road to equality for same-sex couples
entries.snippet: In 2001, same-sex couples in Germany were able to register a civil partnership for the first time. The Civil Partnership Act was a crucial step toward "marriage for all," which was introduced in 2017.
